title: Ask, Seek, Knock
question: What is Jesus promising to the one who keeps asking?
blurb: Three verbs and a Father who answers. Explore what Scripture says about asking.

nodes.content: What is Jesus promising to the one who keeps asking?

nodes.verseText: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
